description: This is a FastAPI route module defining API endpoints for managing production lines, shifts, runs, events, OEE metrics, alerts, reports, and real-time WebSocket updates in a manufacturing monitoring system.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: realtime_docs()
methods.description: Provides WebSocket usage instructions and message types support.

methods.name: list_lines(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of production lines.

methods.name: list_shifts( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves shifts, optionally filtered by line.

methods.name: end_run(run_id: int, payload: RunEnd, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
list_runs( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), shift_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists production runs, with optional filters.

methods.name: create_event(payload: EventCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Logs a production/downtime/quality event, computes OEE, creates alerts, and broadcasts updates.

methods.name: list_events( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), run_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists events, filtered by line or run.

methods.name: get_oee( run_id: int = Query(..., description="Run ID to compute OEE for."), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Computes and returns OEE for a specified run.

methods.name: list_alerts( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), unacknowledged_only: bool = Query(False), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists alerts, optionally filtering by line or unacknowledged only.

methods.name: acknowledge_alert(alert_id: int, payload: AlertAcknowledge, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Acknowledges an alert by setting its acknowledged timestamp.

methods.name: shift_report( line_id: int = Query(...), window_start: datetime = Query(...), window_end: datetime = Query(...), shift_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), run_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Generates a shift report over a specified time window.

methods.name: dict smoke_flow( *, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), line_name: str = Query("Line A", description="Line name to create/use."), target_oee: float = Query(0.85, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="Target OEE for the line."), product_code: str = Query("SKU-1", description="Product code to attach to run."), ideal_cycle_time_s: float = Query(1.0, gt=0, description="Ideal cycle time (s/part)."), planned_production_time_s: int = Query( 3600, gt=0, description="Planned production time (seconds) used for OEE." ), good_count: int = Query(10, ge=0, description="Good count for production event."), scrap_count: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Scrap count for production event."), force_downtime_s: int = Query( 0, ge=0, description="Optional downtime event duration to reduce availability." ), )
methods.description: Performs an end-to-end smoke testing flow: creates line, shift, run, events, computes OEE, triggers alerts, and reports.

methods.name: ws_oee(websocket: WebSocket, line_id: int = Query(..., description="Line ID to subscribe to."))
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint that streams live OEE updates and alerts for a specific line.
